Load relay error

This error relates to a control unit supply problem and cannot be attributed to the actual control unit

Check the state of the battery.

Check the state of the connections and the continuity of the wiring. In particular check the chain of elements providing the supply for the control unit (wiring, fuses, relays, etc.).

Starting enablement relay error

The Selespeed control unit provides the earth for the starting relay block; if a short circuit to the battery or an open circuit is diagnosed, the engine cannot be started. If, conversely, a short circuit to earth is detected, the engine can be started without the go ahead from the Selespeed control unit.

In any case, the problem lies in the parts of the wiring or in systems that enable starting downstream of the Selespeed control unit.

CAN network errors

check

  • that the network monitors all the control units (warning: any control unit connected to the CAN could cause network operating problems).
  • the state of the connections and the continuity of the wiring involving the CAN line. It is a good idea not to be restricted to a visual inspection of the connection but to carry out a test subjecting it to mechanical stress (pull the wires, twist them, check the stability of the pins, etc.).

Brake switch

The signal is received by the Selespeed control unit via the CAN line and via a wire.

Check the state of the brake switch:

Turn the ignition key to the ON position.

Connect the Examiner diagnostic equipment and select the display of the input state (ON/OFF) for the switch on the brake pedal.

Press the brake pedal and check that the value displayed changes (from released to pressed or viceversa).

If there is no change of state, check the switch on the brake pedal, its fastening, its positioning, the state of the connections and the wiring.

Vehicle speed

The vehicle speed signal reaches the Selespeed control unit via the CAN from the ABS control unit therefore any missing/faulty signals in the ABS control unit are also reflected in the Selespeed System.

Check whether there are faults in the ABS control unit and in the engine management control unit that justify the missing vehicle speed signal.

If no faults are detected, use the Examiner Plus or Smart diagnostic equipmentr to check whether there are communication problems on the CAN line.
